title: apricity link shows the session's peers, tempo, playing state and phase
description:
As a performer, I want to see the Link session from the terminal, so that I can check Apricity and the DAW see each other before I play.

Spec file: `features/link/play.feature`.

```gherkin
Feature: apricity link shows the Link session

  Scenario: Looking at a session
    Given a Link session at 124 BPM with 2 other peers, playing
    When I run "apricity link --seconds 2"
    Then it prints "2 peers · 124 BPM · playing" and the bar and beat of the session, updated in place
    And the session's tempo and start/stop are unchanged afterwards

  Scenario: Nobody else is there
    Given no other Link peers
    When I run "apricity link --seconds 2"
    Then it prints "no other Link peers found"
    And a hint that Link needs the DAW's Link switch on, the same network, and local network access for the terminal
    And it exits with status 0

  Scenario: A bad duration
    When I run "apricity link --seconds -1"
    Then it exits with status 2 and prints "--seconds: must be more than 0 (got -1)"
```
